281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and __at least two__ adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, and a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, __the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer being configured to be cured to each other,__ the tool __having__ a circular shape and includ__ing__ a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are __aligned with respective ones of__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises __a non-metallic material__.

283. (Cancelled)

284. (Cancelled)

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, __and wherein the weld ring is separate from the first and second layers__.

286. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

287. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring __extends radially outward beyond__ the outer perimeter of the first and second layers.

289. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented, __with a plurality of circumferentially spaced weld ring segments__.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, __and wherein the inner ring is separate from the first and second layers__.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

292. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring is continuous.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, __the weld ring being separate from the first and second layers__.

294. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

295. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented, __with a plurality of circumferentially spaced weld ring segments__.
